short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Sena, in Divine Voice™ Color — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. A complete 66-book Sena Bible (Bukhu ya Mulungu ya Chisena), paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Ino ndi Bukhu ya Mulungu yakutoma yakudindwa inakwanisa iwe kuona ule analonga. Fala ya Baba wathu iri mu ntundu wa BULUU, ya Mwana mu ntundu WAKUFWIRA, ya Nzimu mu ntundu wa PEPU.

Kwa pyaka pinapita dzana, malemba akufwira akhapangiza pinalonga Mwana. Mbwenye Baba wathu asalonga kakamwe kupita pyenepyo — mu Bukhu ya Mulungu ino ya Cisena fala 109,305 mu mavesi 5,609 — pontho mpaka cincino fala yace yonsene yadindwa na tinta yakuda ibodzi ene ninga madzinza. Iye akhalonga ndzidzi wonsene; nkhabe Bukhu ya Mulungu idakupangiza kuti kupi.

Ntundu ndi cizindikiro ca umwini, nkhabe ca kutsanzira tayu. Fala ya Baba wathu isakhala yace pa muromo onsene unaikwata mwakukhulupirika; fala idakhonda Iye kulonga nkhabe kupaswa ntundu; nkhani isakhala yakuda.
Pidabvundza anyakupfundza momwe anaphembera iwo, Mwana aapasa Baba: “Baba wathu muli kudzulu, dzina yanu mbilemedzwe mwakucena” (Mateu 6:9). Mwa Nzimu tisalira: “Abha! Baba!” (Aroma 8:15).

Iye nkhabe kutali tayu. Nee akhumudwa na iwe tayu. Iye ndi Baba wako wa kudzulu, pontho iwe ndiwe mwanace wakufunika. Khala fala yakuti ‘baba’ si fala ya cibalangazo kuna iwe, Bukhu ya Mulungu ino ndi yako kakamwe.
Bukhu ya Mulungu yakukwana mu volume ibodzi — mabukhu 66, misolo 1,189, mavesi 31,087. Fala yakutoma pa bukhu yonsene, pidziwiso 1,361 pya nyakuwerenga, na pepala yakulemba dzina ya ule unampasa.

Kutcintcwa kwakukhulupirika kubulukira mu Ciheberi, Ciaramu na Cigerego cakutoma; kudinda konsene kusatcintcwa kubulukira mu Father’s Heart Bible™. Cikuto ca pepala na cikuto cakuwanga, yakudindwa na mintundu.
Kuna banja yonsene na ekleziya yonsene inalonga Cisena — ku Mozambique na pa dziko yonsene — toera ibve fala ya Baba mu cilongero cawo.
Tambira Baba wako. Bvesera fala yace. Ntima wace uli pa iwe.

faq.q: Is the Sena edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Sena, 1098 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Sena edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Sena edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Sena text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Sena Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/seh.
